_readme: Map primitive_name -> OSS reference. Builder MUST adapt to HuGR shape (Protocol + invariant_bindings + TLA+ + observability). Copy ALGORITHM, write SHELL. Saves ~70% tokens vs derive-from-scratch.

DeadLetterRoute.notes: Inspect + requeue + purge semantics from SQS DLQ. failure_count + first_failed_at tracking from Celery/Kombu.

PartitionLog.notes: Partition-to-key hash stability, offset monotonicity, truncation-by-retention. Copy the math, not the I/O.

RateLimiter.notes: Token-bucket + sliding-window algorithms battle-tested in limits. Adapt API to HuGR Protocol.

FallbackChain.notes: Primary -> secondary -> cached fallback ordering. Budget-aware short-circuit from Hystrix.

OutlierEjection.notes: consecutive_5xx + success_rate detection, eject -> probation -> rejoin state machine. 3-state per endpoint.

ChaosInjector.notes: Fault injection with allowlist + kill-switch. Percentage targeting. CRITICAL: env-flag gated.

BackpressureSignal.notes: Pressure signal from queue depth + RTT p99. Pause/resume semantics + hysteresis.

TokenMeter.notes: Monotonic counter per (model, operation). Concurrent-increment safe via lock.

BudgetGuard.notes: Pre-check budget before call; bill after. Hard cap vs soft warning thresholds.

StateStore.notes: get/set/delete + CAS + TTL. Key-collision-free via namespace prefix.

WorkflowSignal.notes: Signal = external async message to running workflow. Queued per workflow_id.

ModelRegistry.notes: version / stage transitions (None -> Staging -> Production -> Archived). Audit every transition.

VectorStore.notes: upsert/query/delete + metadata filter + distance metric (cosine/l2/dot). Embedding dim validated.

InputGuardrail.notes: Pre-inference validators: PII, profanity, jailbreak, schema. Chain of validators; first-fail short-circuit.

OutputGuardrail.notes: Post-inference validators: hallucination detection, PII leak, citation check, schema conformance.

HumanCheckpoint.notes: Pause workflow at checkpoint; await human approve/reject/edit; resume with human decision in state.

EvalHarness.notes: Test suite runner: dataset + scorer + threshold. Deterministic seeds. Regression on metric deltas.

ResponseCache.notes: Key = hash(model, prompt, params). TTL + LRU eviction. Cache-hit bypasses LLM.

ModelRouter.notes: Route to model by: cost / latency / capability / tenant policy. Fallback ladder. Cost-aware selection.

ToolSchema.notes: JSON Schema for tool params. Validate before dispatch. Strict-mode rejects unknown keys.

PromptInjectionFilter.notes: Detect jailbreak attempts: system-prompt override, delimiter injection, RAG poisoning. Return confidence + block recommendation.
